title: Looped Diffusion Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2609.40305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. translated_abstract: 提升文生图模型的传统方法通常依赖于增加模型规模或去噪步数。在这项工作中，我们探索了一种替代性的计算扩展方式：在每个去噪步骤内反复运行共享的Transformer模块，从而在保持参数数量不变的情况下有效增加计算深度。这种循环计算无需显式推理token即可实现对内部表示的迭代细化。然而，简单的循环方式并不能持续改善图像质量。我们将这一问题归因于中间循环之间缺乏充分监督，以及不受约束的注意力更新会逐渐侵蚀局部信息。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了循环扩散Transformer（Looped-DiT），它将跨中间循环的深度监督与自调制注意力相结合，以稳定循环过程中的特征更新。在参数匹配和计算量匹配的实验设置下，Looped-DiT...
tldr: 该论文提出Looped-DiT，通过在每个去噪步骤内循环运行共享Transformer模块，并结合深度监督与自调制注意力机制，在参数量固定的情况下提升文生图模型的计算深度和图像生成质量。
en_tdlr: Looped-DiT improves text-to-image quality by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, using deep supervision and self-modulating attention to stabilize feature updates while keeping the parameter count fixed.
